review.note: M59: 1885 is where Historical Basemaps stops, not where this polity ended. No record beginning in 1886 overlaps this ground at all, under any name, and Wikidata gives no dissolution this record could cite (docs/m59-singletons.md). The end here is the horizon of the source and nothing more. The summary says that of the whole interval; this says it of the end, which is the number a reader takes for a fact.

summary: A polity the Historical Basemaps dataset draws in the snapshots for 1715, 1783, 1800, 1815, 1878 and 1880. That dataset is a set of world border snapshots from antiquity to the twentieth century; it is its authors' work in progress and asks to be checked against other sources before use. The interval on this record is the span those snapshots cover, 1715 to 1885, and not a claim about when this polity began or ended: a snapshot says where a border was drawn for one year, and the years between two of them are assumed. This record was written by the import from those fields and asserts nothing the dataset does not.
